set.body:
Do: SD6 -- a fresh-context agent reviews the whole subsystem with no memory of writing it. Because re-reading catches prose and shape but NOT a wrong number, run every mutant named across these beads and record each death BY NAME.

A surviving mutant is a finding about the TEST and must be recorded, never quietly replaced.

Evidence document in docs/plans/ carrying: the gate command from `bash tools/reference-scope.sh "$(git merge-base main CAND)" CAND` (never guessed), bound TEST TOTALS with command receipts (SD2: a run with no test totals did not run), the dead-mutant list, and what the evidence does NOT establish. Amend the ADR with everything P3 and P4 forced.

WHERE TO LOOK HARDEST. Three review passes on the plan each found holes the previous pass had accepted, and the recurring shape was identical every time: A CARRIER NAMED "verified" OR "known" WHOSE STATUS IS PUBLICLY CONSTRUCTIBLE. Scala 3 enum cases are case classes. The two sites with that shape and no pass of their own are NotApplicable's Applicability predicate and CorpusProfile's identity checksum. Probe both from storymodel4s.consumer.

Exit: a receipt whose claims each have a runnable falsifier behind them.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3 P8
set.title: intake P8: cold review, mutation sweep, and the evidence receipt
